data.desc: Portillo's (NASDAQ: PTLO) has grown from a small hot dog trailer in Chicago to more than 100 restaurants across 11 states. Known for its diverse menu of Chicago-style favorites like Italian beef sandwiches, Chicago-style hot dogs, char-broiled burgers, fresh salads and signature chocolate cake, Portillo's is beloved in both its home of Chicagoland and across new and growing markets. Portillo's operates a company-owned model of not just restaurants, but experience-focused destinations that blend dine-in, drive-thru, takeout and delivery to serve guests with the food they crave. And now, after six decades of success and counting, Portillo's is on a mission to bring its iconic food and unforgettable dining experience to guests across the country.
